title: 30000170: publish audited complex quadratic stability result
body:
The stable complex-quadratic coefficient set has nonunique nearest projections arbitrarily close to z². The audited proof gives a negative degree-two answer to Lewis’s historical complex monic stable-set question, including full exact-degree coefficients and every fixed positive-definite real coefficient inner product. It also proves failure of whole-abscissa-epigraph set prox-regularity. A separate positive proposition proves Euclidean monic-quadratic function prox-regularity relative to each finite limiting subgradient, with constants depending on that subgradient.

Published research note and exact verification archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23306332. The Google Workspace CLI tracker entry is verified at Math Puzzles A60:D60.

The source audit credits classical stability geometry, prior root/projection calculus, and prior closest-polynomial work. OWR’s omitted field, normalization and metric are disclosed. Read extents and unread-source gaps remain explicit; no firstness, present-openness, general real-coefficient or all-degree claim is made.

Validation includes independent mathematical and priority approaches, exact rational checks, two successive independent whole-preprint reviews with the first delivery issue repaired globally and the second review clean, all six PDF pages inspected, and actual public metadata/PDF/archive readbacks. The final integration adversary verified all 133 selected files, the single QUEUE row, and all 159,673 conserved other leaves. The original submission and exact-version reviews are preserved. Author search turns remain 1/5.

This is an unrefereed research note. AI tools were used extensively in solving, preparing and verifying the work; there has been no independent human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification.
